popular_name: Least Restrictive Alternative — Minor Conservatee Limitation
case_relevance: Minor conservatee question: §1800.3(a) limits Prob. Code conservatorship to married minors — an unmarried 14-year-old cannot be subject to §1801 conservatorship; mechanism must have been guardianship, LPS, or DDS pathway
Least restrictive alternative: §1800.3(b) mandatory finding required before any appointment; absence of that finding in the order = defective appointment
